title: Lipschitz extension of a map into ℝ^P with a √P loss (componentwise McShane)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, S ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P), ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that ψ is K-Lipschitz on S, i.e. |ψ(x) − ψ(y)| ≤ K|x − y| for all x, y ∈ S. Then there is φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P which is (√P·K)-Lipschitz on all of ℝ^P (Lipschitz constant NNReal.sqrt P * K) and agrees with ψ on S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (K : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith K ψ S → ∃ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt P * K) φ ∧ EqOn φ ψ S
